capture.presentation: Illustration of a six-object scene and three cameras. The depth view is computed from the same geometry in camera space, not a real sensor recording.
capture.geometry: Native MuJoCo duck and XHand; original PartNet-Mobility 811 faucet and RBO pliers from the local reconstruction workbench; smooth procedural mug and bottle. Articulated motion follows source joint limits and FK.

representation.presentation: Surface-sampled point clouds and mesh surface normals of the same objects. The XHand uses native mesh/link poses exported from the MuJoCo demo. These explanatory views are not claimed learned reconstruction outputs.
representation.label: SDF / Normal; the lower row retains its surface-normal visualization.

optimization.presentation: MuJoCo renders the recorded reach and accepted WS optimizer states. No old procedural teaching hand is used.
optimization.gradient_arrows: Actual frozen-objective negative joint gradient mapped through the XHand FK Jacobian, with a common per-frame display scale.
optimization.loss_curve: Re-evaluated original objective, preserving recorded contact-activation state.
optimization.scope: Optimizer replay; not a new MuJoCo dynamics, force-closure or collision-free grasp validation.

execution.presentation: Recorded real XHand duck approach, grasp and lift; loop synchronized to the 10-second figure.

generation: No AI-generated imagery. First two panels are code-rendered illustrations; third is native MuJoCo rendering; fourth is the supplied hardware recording.
